items.title: 3.6 Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.6 with Figs. 3.18 to 3.23 (PDF 68-71).

blocks.title: Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon
blocks.text: Agar system par koi bahri torque na lage to system ka kul angular momentum mustaqil rehta hai: L_total = L1 + L2 + ... = mustaqil.

Angular momentum ke baqa ka qanoon physics ke bunyadi usoolon mein se hai; yeh kainati (cosmological) se sub-microscopic satah tak sabit hua hai. Us ka asar tab saaf nazar aata hai jab ek akela ghoomta jism apna moment of inertia badle: agar moment of inertia I1 ka jism angular speed omega1 se ghoomta hua apna moment of inertia I2 kar le to us ki angular speed omega2 bhi yun badalti hai ke us ka angular momentum mustaqil rahe, is liye I1 omega1 = I2 omega2. Angular momentum vector quantity hai jis ki simt gardish ke axis ke saath hai, to axis ke saath angular momentum ki simt bhi fixed rehti hai: kisi cheez ka gardish ka axis apna rukh nahi badlega jab tak koi bahri torque use na badle. Yeh haqeeqat Suraj ke gird chalti Zameen ke liye bohat aham hai: Zameen koi aur qabil-e-zikr torque mehsoos nahi karti, kyunke us par lagne wali bari force Suraj ki kheench hai, to hamare gird kainat ki nisbat Zameen ki gardish ka axis ek simt mein fixed rehta hai.
Angular momentum ke baqa ki misalein
Diving board se kudta aadmi

Springboard se kudte diver ko pani ki satah chhoone se pehle hawa mein kuch qalabaziyan leni parti hain (Fig. 3.18). Springboard chhorne ke baad woh haath aur taangein samet kar jism gol karta hai; us ka moment of inertia ghatta hai aur woh hawa mein bari angular velocity se ghoomta hai. Pani ki satah chhoone ke qareeb woh haath aur taangein phaila deta hai, halki speed se pani mein dakhil hota hai aur hamwar dive karta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek hi diver ki kai haalatein: board par chalta, ghutna uthata, haath oopar kar ke seedha phaila hua chhalang lagata, phir teen qalabazi (somersault) ki haalaton mein simta hua, sunehri teer gardish dikhate hain, aur aakhir mein sar ke bal seedha phaila hua pani mein dakhil hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.18: Diving board se chhalang lagata aadmi (kitab ki Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh tasveeron ka silsila hai; yahan saada khaake ki shakal mein banaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hawa mein diver par koi bahri torque nahi, is liye us ka angular momentum L = I omega mustaqil rehta hai. Simat kar (haath paon andar) woh I ghatata hai to omega barhta hai aur woh tez qalabaziyan leta hai. Pani ke qareeb phail kar woh I barhata hai, omega ghatta hai aur woh aaram se seedha pani mein jata hai.
Ghoomta ice skater

Ice skater baazu mor kar aur phaili taang doosri taang ke qareeb la kar apni angular velocity barha sakta hai; aisa kar ke woh apna moment of inertia ghatata hai, to angular speed barhti hai. Jab woh haath aur ek taang bahar phailata hai to moment of inertia barhta hai aur angular velocity ghatti hai: angular momentum = (moment of inertia)(angular velocity), L = I x omega.

blocks.alt: Skater ke do saamne ke manzar. Baen, I - large, omega - small: baazu daen baen phaile, baazuon ke gird chaurra surkh chhalla aur pairon ke gird chhota. Daen, I - small, omega - large: baazu seene par mude aur taangein saath, seene se pairon tak jism ke gird chhote surkh chhalle. Neeche: Angular momentum = (Moment of inertia)(Angular velocity), L = I x omega.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.19: Angular momentum istemal karta ice skater (kitab ki Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Turntable par khara haathon mein wazan uthaye shakhs

Ek shakhs dono taraf phaile haathon mein bhari masses (dumb-bells) le kar turntable par khara hai; jaise woh haath andar kheenchta hai us ki angular speed foran barhti hai, kyunke haath andar kheenchne par moment of inertia ghatta hai, jo angular speed barhata hai.

blocks.alt: Turntable par khare aadmi ke do khaake, har haath mein dumb-bell. (a) Baazu daen baen phaile, haathon ke raaste ke gird dashed daira. (b) Baazu andar, dumb-bells pehluon ke qareeb. Har sar ke oopar chhota mura teer gardish dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.20: Turntable par haathon mein masses liye aadmi; angular momentum ke baqa ki wajah se baazu andar kheenchne par angular velocity barhti hai (kitab ki Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh do tasveerein (photographs) hain; yahan saade khaake ki shakal mein banai gayi hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein masses axis se door hain, to I bara aur gardish sust hai. (b) mein masses andar aa gayi hain, I chhota ho gaya, aur kyunke I omega mustaqil rehna chahiye, omega barh jata hai: aadmi tez ghoomne lagta hai.
Flywheel

Axle wale bhari pahiye par mushtamil mechanical device, jo gardishi energy mehfooz karne, output ke utaar charhao hamwar karne aur cycles aur doosri gariyon, sanati machinery, gyroscopes, bahri jahazon aur spacecraft jaise bohat se istemalat mein istehkam dene ko istemal hota hai. Jab flywheel ghoomta hai to us ka angular momentum us ke rukh ki tabdeeliyon ki muzahimat karta hai, istehkam qaim rakhte hue, jo un systems mein mufeed hai jinhen bahri mudakhlat ke baghair apne rukh par sahih qaboo chahiye. Balance wheel kehlane wala flywheel oscillation ki qaboo shuda raftar qaim rakh kar mechanical gharion aur watches ka waqt-rakhne ka nizam regulate karta hai (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Bhari disc, mota gehra kinara aur neela saamna jis ke beech hub aur bolt ke surakh hain; yeh ek axle par lagi hai jo chhote neele collar se guzar kar baen taraf nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.21: Flywheel (kitab ki Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kitab mein yeh tasveer (photograph) hai; yahan saade khaake ki shakal mein banai gayi hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flywheel ka zyada mass mote kinare mein, axis se door hota hai, is liye us ka moment of inertia bara hai. Bara I matlab ghoomte hue bara angular momentum, jo speed aur rukh mein achanak tabdeeli ki muzahimat karta hai; is tarah machine ki raftar hamwar rehti hai.
Gyroscope

Zameen ke axis ki nisbat apna rukh qaim rakhne, ya apne rukh ki tabdeeliyon ki muzahimat ke liye istemal hone wala device. Yeh sahare ke chhallon mein pivoted lage flywheel par mushtamil hai aur apne bare moment of inertia ki wajah se angular momentum ke baqa ke qanoon par kaam karta hai. Bari angular speed se ghoomte hue yeh bara angular momentum pata hai, to us ke gardishi axis ka rukh badalna mushkil hai: rukh ki tabdeeli ko angular momentum ki tabdeeli chahiye, aur bare angular momentum ki simt badalne ko utna hi bara torque chahiye. Gyroscope jhuka ho tab bhi gire baghair utha rehta hai. Gyroscope ke bare istemalat hawai jahazon, aabdozon aur khalai gariyon ke rehnuma nizam mein hain, taake khala mein khaas simt qaim aur rasta seedha rahe.

blocks.alt: Stand par gyroscope: bhari rotor ufuqi axle par, jo andaruni chhalle, ufuqi chhalle aur stand par tike bahri chhalle mein laga hai. Axle ke saath baen taraf surkh teer par L = I omega aur Angular momentum likha hai. Daen taraf axle ke sire ke gird mura teer par Spin axis likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.22: Gyroscope (kitab ki Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen chhalle (rings) rotor ko har taraf azaad rakhte hain, is liye stand ko ghumane se bhi rotor par torque nahi lagta. Tez ghoomte rotor ka angular momentum L = I omega spin axis ke saath hai, aur torque ke baghair yeh mustaqil rehta hai; is liye axle apna rukh nahi badalta. Isi liye gyroscope jahazon aur khalai gariyon ki simt qaim rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Stand par gyroscope ka 3D model: bhari gehra rotor aik axle par ghoomta hai jo neeli andaruni gimbal ring mein laga hai; yeh ring stand par tiki naranji bahari gimbal ring ke andar ghoom sakti hai. Axle ke saath surkh teer angular momentum L = I omega dikhata hai, jo spin axis ke saath hai.
blocks.caption: Gyroscope ka 3D model (hamara apna saada model, do gimbal rings ke saath; kitab ki Figure 3.22 mein teen chhalle hain; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Dono gimbal rings axle ko har simt mein azaad rakhti hain, stand us par zor nahi dalta; is liye jab rotor tez ghoomta hai to us ka angular momentum L = I omega axle ko usi simt mein rakhta hai, chahe stand ko jhukayein ya ghumayein.

fallback.text: Gyroscope: do gimbal rings mein tez ghoomta rotor apna spin axis (angular momentum L = I omega) usi simt mein rakhta hai.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: Gimbal rings mein gyroscope.

blocks.caption: Side notes
rows: ruki cycle par baithein to girte hain, magar chalti cycle ke ghoomte pahiyon ka angular momentum kisi tabdeeli ki muzahimat karta hai aur cycle ko seedha aur mustehkam rakhne mein madad deta hai
ungli ke gird lipat-ti dori par gend dori chhoti hone par tez hoti hai

jab qutbi barf pighal kar dariyaon ki shakal mein beh jati hai to pani ka aur is liye Zameen ka apne axis ke gird moment of inertia barhta hai; angular momentum ke baqa se Zameen ki angular velocity ghatti hai, to din lamba hota hai
coasting ghoomta system (funnel) beaker mein pani tapakne par sust kyun hota hai?
sayyare elliptical madaron mein chalte hain jin ke ek focus par Suraj hai; Suraj ke qareeb sayyare ki madari velocity khud barh jati hai; kyun?

blocks.alt: Haath ki shahadat ki ungli oopar. Ungli ke gird lipti dori ek gend tak jati hai. Halki naqlein pehle ki haalatein dikhati hain jab dori lambi thi; abhi ki gend, sab se chhoti dori par, us ki harkat ka teer rakhti hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 68): dori ungli ke gird lipatne par gend ki speed barhti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dori lipatne se gend ka radius chhota hota hai, to moment of inertia ghatta hai. Angular momentum barabar rehne ke liye angular velocity barhti hai, aur gend tez ghoomne lagti hai, bilkul skater ki tarah.

blocks.alt: Haath beaker ke oopar dropper pakre hue hai; pani ke qatre beaker mein girte hain. Beaker naranji ghoomte platform par hai jis ke neeche funnel jaisa danda hai, aur mura teer dikhata hai ke platform ghoom raha hai.
blocks.caption: Point to Ponder (PDF page 70): coasting ghoomta system beaker mein pani tapakne par sust kyun hota hai? (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Qatre seedhe neeche girte hain, un ka apna angular momentum taqreeban sifr hai. Beaker mein pani jama hone se system ka mass aur is liye moment of inertia barhta hai. Kul angular momentum wahi rehta hai, to angular velocity ghat jati hai aur system sust ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Diver board se I = 18 kg m^2 ke saath nikalta hai, simat kar 3.6 kg m^2 karta hai aur simte hue 1.0 s mein do chakkar leta hai. Agar woh na simat-ta to board se pani tak 1.5 s mein kitni revolutions karta (numerical problem 3.10)? Kawwa ghoomti plate se roti utha leta hai aur plate tez ho jati hai; kyun (constructed response 3.2)?
blocks.explanation: Simte hue omega2 = 2 rev s^-1; I1 omega1 = I2 omega2 se omega1 = 3.6 x 2 / 18 = 0.4 rev s^-1, to 1.5 s mein woh 0.4 x 1.5 = 0.6 rev karta. Roti hatane se ghoomte system ka moment of inertia ghatta hai; bahri torque na hone par L = I omega mustaqil hai, to angular velocity barhti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Bahri torque nahi: L_total mustaqil, I1 omega1 = I2 omega2; axis apna rukh rakhta hai (Zameen ka axis fixed rehta hai).

Misalein: diver aur skater (haath paon andar, I kam, omega zyada), turntable par shakhs, flywheel (energy mehfooz, machinein hamwar, gharion mein balance wheel), gyroscope (bara L rukh badalne ki muzahimat; hawai jahaz, aabdoz, spacecraft ki rehnumai).
